summary: editable-contracts@0.0.15 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime for the host platform from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style string-array plus rotator, hex-named identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) and has no relationship to the package's stated purpose of providing a small TypeScript library for editable JSON contracts. Executing an obfuscated bundled script through a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime at install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern used to evade Node-based scanners and to run arbitrary attacker-controlled code in the installer's environment.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
